subject: SIG initiation & evidence prefill — MediSync evaluation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisync.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG initiation & evidence prefill — MediSync evaluation

Hi Laura — great to talk this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned: 

Summary from call
- Use case: embedding-based search + summarization on customer support logs (PII/PHI considerations discussed)
- Primary concern: HIPAA compliance + SOC 2 evidence readiness; you mentioned an active SOC 2 program and anticipated Type II by later this year
- Integration model: hosted Redwood API for early pilot, Dedicated later for predictable throughput

Specific asks / clarifying questions
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type I/II report available today or a target date? If in-flight, do you have a SOC 2 roadmap or gap document you can share?
2) Data residency / PHI: you indicated MediSync may process PHI — please confirm whether a BAA is required for the pilot.
3) Questionnaire preference: do you prefer SIG Lite, full SIG/CAIQ, or a custom security worksheet? If SIG/CAIQ, do you have a prefilled version you can share?
4) Evidence POC: who on your side will own evidence collection (SCRUM name/email) so we can route asks precisely?

Attachments: I attached a short SIG prefill template we typically share to speed the first pass (Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx). If you prefer a different format we can adapt.

Proposed next steps (if agreeable)
- You: confirm SOC 2 status and point of contact for evidence by EOD Wed, Mar 10
- Us: prepare a prioritized SIG-Lite prefill and list of 8-10 initial evidence items we’ll need for the pilot
- Joint: 30-min follow-up next week to align owners and timeline

If helpful, I can loop in our security engineer (Laura Bennett) and our compliance lead (Priyom Das) to help with any detailed evidence asks.

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (stub)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisync.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medisync.io
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 17:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence prefill — MediSync evaluation

Hi Rishi — thanks for the concise recap. Confirming details from our side below: 

1) SOC 2: We do not have a Type II report today. We completed a Type I in Q4 2026 and have a Type II engagement scheduled for August 2027. I attached a one-page roadmap that highlights the milestones (MediSync_Security_Roadmap.pdf).

2) PHI / BAA: Yes — we will handle PHI for the pilot customers and will require a BAA (we have a standard template we can share).

3) Questionnaire preference: SIG-Lite would be ideal to start (less overhead). We can provide a prefilled SIG-Lite and later expand to CAIQ if needed.

4) Evidence POC: security@medisync.io is the best inbox for evidence requests right now. The lead is David Park (david.park@medisync.io).

We attached a vCard for the security inbox owner for your convenience.

Next steps from us:
- I’ll get you the SIG-Lite prefill by Tue, Mar 9 (EOD our timezone)
- I’ll also attach our BAA draft for review

Let me know if you want to kick off with the 8-10 priority items you mentioned — that would help our security team triage.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships | MediSync
laura.chen@medisync.io

--
Attachments: MediSync_Security_Roadmap.pdf (stub), MediSync_Security_Contact.vcf (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisync.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 18:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence prefill — MediSync evaluation

Laura — perfect, this is helpful and appreciated. Quick confirmation of our proposed plan and a few follow-ups so we can get the SIG prefill moving: 

Plan
- Redwood: we’ll prepare a SIG-Lite prefill and highlight a prioritized set of ~10 evidence items (security architecture diagram, encryption at rest/in transit statements, user access reviews, incident response runbook excerpt, SOC roadmap excerpt).
- You: share the SIG-Lite prefill and BAA draft (target Tue, Mar 9).
- Joint: 30-min sync to align owners — I’ll propose times for Wed/Thu next week once I have confirmation from our security team.

Clarifying questions
- SOC 2 Type I details: can you confirm the auditor name and coverage date for the Type I? we include that in our compliance mapping.
- Data segmentation: for the pilot, will PHI be segregated into a dedicated tenant or logical separation in your environment? any notes help with evidence mapping.
- Templating preference: do you want us to send the SIG-Lite as an editable XLSX (we sent one earlier) or as a prefilled PDF for tracking? XLSX is easier for collaborative prefill.

If OK I'll share the prioritized evidence list by EOB tomorrow and attach the prefill XLSX for your team to start populating. Monica / Laura B — looping you both for quick confirmation on the evidence list cadence: do you prefer that we open discrete requests in a shared Drive folder (link below) or route asks through the security@medisync.io inbox?

Drive (for initial evidence upload): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefExampleRedwood/MediSync-SIG

Thanks — I’ll wait for the prefill and BAA draft and will follow up with a calendar invite once we agree on timing.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
